map_notes: `building-entrence-34-36-38` traces the Firin block on the north-west corner. The previous east-west split created a cut-off roof patch beside the wooden building. Render this as one continuous bakery mass with one coherent TR/tile roof, while keeping multiple conservative west-side entrances for the numbered frontage.
